clf-avc-036.text: A CTO needs to build an HR management application on AWS. The development team does not have expertise managing operating systems, infrastructure, or load balancers and wants to focus mainly on application code and business logic. Which cloud service model and AWS service best fit this requirement?
options: Software as a Service (SaaS) using Amazon WorkSpaces.
Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) using Amazon EC2.
Platform as a Service (PaaS) using AWS Elastic Beanstalk.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using AWS CloudFormation.
clf-avc-036.explanation: AWS Elastic Beanstalk provides a PaaS-style experience where developers deploy application code while AWS automates much of the environment provisioning, load balancing, scaling, monitoring, and platform maintenance.
clf-avc-036.hint: Think of the service model where developers focus on their application while the platform manages much of the runtime and infrastructure.
optionRationales: Elastic Beanstalk is a PaaS-style service that lets developers focus on code while the platform manages the environment.
EC2 is IaaS and leaves the guest operating system and more infrastructure administration to the customer.
WorkSpaces is a managed virtual desktop service, not an application-development PaaS.
CloudFormation is an infrastructure-provisioning tool and IaC practice, not the cloud service model described.

clf-avc-037.text: An e-commerce company wants to reduce the environmental impact of its AWS workloads under the shared-responsibility concept for sustainability. Which action is directly under the customer's control?
options: Configure the liquid cooling architecture of racks hosting the instances EC2 and the storages of EBS.
Select Energy Sources 100% renewable to supply cooling and air-conditioning systems of the data centres of the AWS.
Optimize application design with serverless architectures and efficient Amazon S3 data-lifecycle policies.
Manage physical hardware recycling for decommissioned AWS servers.
clf-avc-037.explanation: Customers are responsible for sustainability IN the cloud by designing efficient workloads, improving utilization, reducing idle compute, and managing data efficiently. AWS manages sustainability OF the cloud infrastructure itself.
clf-avc-037.hint: The customer controls how its software consumes compute and storage, not AWS's physical facilities.
optionRationales: Efficient serverless design and lifecycle management reduce unnecessary customer resource consumption.
AWS controls power sourcing and data-center infrastructure.
AWS manages the physical lifecycle and recycling of its hardware.
Customers do not manage rack cooling or electrical systems in AWS facilities.

clf-avc-038.text: AWS Trusted Advisor reports that some EC2 instances average less than 10% CPU utilization and also identifies network ports exposed unnecessarily to the public internet. Which Trusted Advisor categories cover these findings, respectively?
clf-avc-038.explanation: Underutilized compute represents financial waste and maps to Cost Optimization, while unnecessarily exposed network access is a Security concern.
clf-avc-038.hint: The Trusted Advisor analyzes its infrastructure actively against best practices and divides into five fundamental pillars of checking.
optionRationales: Low utilization is a cost issue and exposed ports are a security issue.
Fault tolerance concerns resilience and redundancy, not primarily idle cost and public exposure.
Service quotas do not describe these findings, and Sustainability is not the relevant Trusted Advisor category here.
Cloud Concepts and Corporate Governance are not Trusted Advisor check categories.

clf-avc-039.text: A digital-media organization wants to launch a new streaming product in several international markets at the same time. Executives say AWS will reduce time to market and improve business agility. Which technical cloud characteristic best supports this claim?
options: Eliminating all software QA and staging requirements before production.
Provisioning global compute and storage resources programmatically in minutes without waiting for physical hardware procurement.
Automatically and obligatorily refactoring all legacy code into microservices.
Having AWS absorb all third-party enterprise software licensing costs.
clf-avc-039.explanation: Cloud agility comes from rapid on-demand infrastructure provisioning. Teams can create and remove environments through APIs in minutes instead of waiting for hardware purchasing and installation.
clf-avc-039.hint: Agility is about reducing the infrastructure waiting time between an idea and an environment ready for experimentation or launch.
optionRationales: Rapid programmatic provisioning is the technical foundation for improved time to market.
AWS does not remove the need for testing and quality assurance.
Modernization requires deliberate engineering; AWS does not automatically rewrite customer applications.
Third-party licensing remains governed by the applicable licensing model and customer choices.
